camel_example: aliyun ims ChangePassword --region cn-hangzhou --NewPassword newpassword --OldPassword mypassword
description_en: Changes the password that is used to log on to the console for a Resource Access Management (RAM) user
description_zh: RAM用户为自己修改控制台登录密码
kebab_example: aliyun ims change-password --old-password mypassword --new-password newpassword --region cn-hangzhou
name: ChangePassword

parameters.help_en: The old password that is used to log on to the console
parameters.help_zh: RAM用户的控制台登录旧密码
parameters.name: old_password

parameters.help_en:
The new password that is used to log on to the console.

The password must meet the complexity requirements. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186691.html
parameters.help_zh:
RAM用户的控制台登录新密码。

密码必须符合密码强度要求。关于如何获取密码强度要求，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/186691.html
parameters.name: new_password
